# ActiveState

> ActiveState provides a secure, curated platform for managing open-source software dependencies and container security across the supply chain.

ActiveState offers comprehensive documentation and tools for developers and teams to secure their software supply chain, including the State Tool for dependency management, the Curated Catalog for vetted open-source packages, and Academy for learning secure practices. The platform includes real-time service status monitoring to ensure reliability.

## Key Topics

- ActiveState Platform
- State Tool
- Curated Catalog
- ActiveState Academy
- Container Catalog
- Open-source security
- Supply chain security
- Container security
- Secure containers
- Documentation
- Getting started
- Platform services
- System status
